title: Smallest Value of the Rearranged Number
goal: Rearrange the digits into the smallest number with the original sign and no leading zero.
strategy: For a positive number, use ascending digits but move the smallest nonzero digit to the front. For a negative number, the smallest signed value has the largest magnitude, so use descending digits.
